text:
Tasha: Heads-up — NimbusBio flagged INV-2026-09-12. They say a scheduled failover routed traffic to a fallback pool and they were billed burst charges for ~22 minutes. They want a refund + SLA credit.

Leo: tagging @rebecca for attribution recon. Can you pull pool assignment logs for 2026-09-12 01:05-01:30 UTC? Customer insists requests should have remained on nimbus-ded-4.

Rebecca: pulling now. Initial find: during maintenance the region priority list dropped their reserved pool because a node returned an unexpected health status. Routing fell back to shared-host for ~22m.

Rebecca: snippet:
```assignments:
2026-09-12T01:08Z -> shared-host
2026-09-12T01:30Z -> nimbus-ded-4```
Estimated overcharge = $9,720.

Tasha: Nimbus has a 12-month commit and good relationship. They prefer a cash refund. Policy reminder?

Finance-bot: Policy: cash refunds > $5k require director + legal approval. SLA credits <= 15% can be applied automatically if within policy limits; manual approvals available.

Leo: charge ids: CHG-15678, CHG-15679. Reconciliation worksheet in ticket #4621 with minute-level breakdown and logs. Root cause appears to be a flaky health probe that mis-marked nodes during the maintenance window.

Rebecca: engineering note — infra will patch the probe debounce logic to avoid transient false negatives. We'll also add an assignment audit flag for easier future recon. ETA for patch: 48h.

Tasha: proposed remediation: refund full overcharge $9,720 + 6% SLA credit applied to next invoice as goodwill. Need sam + legal.

Legal-bot: Contract review complete. SOW clause 2.4 permits "credit or refund" for failure to provide reserved capacity. Recommend a short amendment outlining refund and mitigation.

Sam: I'm willing to approve the cash refund and 6% SLA credit. Please document mitigation and route memo to finance-approvals.

Finance-bot: To proceed: run `/process-refund CHG-15678,CHG-15679 amount=9720 ticket=4621 note="NimbusBio - reserved pool misattribution during maintenance"` and attach approvals. This will pause auto-pay until processed.

Tasha: I'll run the command and send the customer message: corrected invoice, refund amount, SLA credit, summary of root cause and upcoming fix. Rebecca — please attach the logs to ticket #4621.

Infra-bot: Patch scheduled: probe-debounce-fix v1.2 deployed to canary at 2026-09-13T04:12Z. No regressions observed. Full rollout ETA 2026-09-14T02:00Z.

Rebecca: Logs uploaded to ticket #4621, with per-minute breakdown and the probe trace.

Tasha: Thanks everyone — proceeding with refund workflow and customer comms. Will update thread when refund posts and ticket is closed. :white_check_mark:
